mapper.select: /* AppAttd01Mapper.selectScheduleByRange */ SELECT WP.WORK_YMD AS workYmd , WP.WORK_PLAN_CD AS workPlanCd , SC.SCH_CD AS schCd , SC.SCH_NO AS schNo , SC.SCH_TYPE AS schType , SC.FST_SCH_STR_TIME AS fstSchStrTime , SC.FST_SCH_END_TIME AS fstSchEndTime , SC.FST_SCH_BRK_MIN AS fstSchBrkMin , SC.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME AS secSchStrTime , SC.SEC_SCH_END_TIME AS secSchEndTime , SC.SEC_SCH_BRK_MIN AS secSchBrkMin , NULL AS leaveCd , NULL AS leaveNm FROM TB_USER_WORK_PLAN WP LEFT JOIN TB_SCH_MGMT SC ON SC.CMPNY_CD = WP.CMPNY_CD AND SC.SITE_CD = WP.SITE_CD AND SC.SCH_CD = WP.WORK_PLAN_CD WHERE WP.CMPNY_CD = #{q.cmpnyCd} AND WP.SITE_CD = #{q.siteCd} AND WP.USER_CD = #{q.userCd} AND WP.WORK_YMD BETWEEN #{q.fromYmd} AND #{q.toYmd} ORDER BY WP.WORK_YMD

/* AppAttd01Mapper.selectAttdByRange */ SELECT A.ATTD_ID AS attdId , A.WORK_YMD AS workYmd , A.WORK_SEQ AS workSeq , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , S.SITE_NM AS siteNm , A.CHECK_IN_DATE AS checkInDate , A.CHECK_IN_TIME AS checkInTime , A.CHECK_IN_METHOD AS checkInMethod , A.CHECK_OUT_DATE AS checkOutDate , A.CHECK_OUT_TIME AS checkOutTime , A.CHECK_OUT_METHOD AS checkOutMethod FROM TB_USER_ATTD_MGMT A LEFT JOIN TB_SITE S ON S.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND S.SITE_CD = A.SITE_CD WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{q.cmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{q.siteCd} AND A.USER_CD = #{q.userCd} AND A.WORK_YMD BETWEEN #{q.fromYmd} AND #{q.toYmd} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY A.WORK_YMD, A.WORK_SEQ

/* AppAttd01Mapper.selectHolidaysByRange */ SELECT DATE_FORMAT(H.HOLIDAY_YMD, '%Y%m%d') AS holidayYmd , H.HOLIDAY_NM AS holidayNm , H.HOLIDAY_TYPE AS holidayType FROM TB_HOLIDAY H WHERE H.CMPNY_CD = #{q.cmpnyCd} AND H.USE_YN = 'Y' AND H.HOLIDAY_YMD BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(#{q.fromYmd}, '%Y%m%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(#{q.toYmd}, '%Y%m%d')

/* AppAttd01Mapper.selectLeaveUseByRange */ SELECT U.START_DATE AS startDate , U.END_DATE AS endDate , U.LEAVE_CD AS leaveCd , LT.LEAVE_NM AS leaveNm , U.LEAVE_DAYS AS leaveDays
, U.USE_UNIT_TYPE AS useUnitType , U.START_TIME AS startTime , U.END_TIME AS endTime , U.LEAVE_MINUTES AS leaveMinutes FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE U LEFT JOIN TB_LEAVE_TYPE_MGMT LT ON LT.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND LT.LEAVE_CD = U.LEAVE_CD WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{q.cmpnyCd} AND U.SITE_CD = #{q.siteCd} AND U.USER_CD = #{q.userCd} AND U.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' AND U.START_DATE <= #{q.toYmd} AND U.END_DATE >= #{q.fromYmd}
/* AppAttd01Mapper.selectGpsId */ SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), FNC_CMM_SEQ_NEXTVAL(#{cmpnyCd}, 'GPS_ID')) AS gpsId
/* AppAttd01Mapper.selectAttdId */ SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), FNC_CMM_SEQ_NEXTVAL(#{cmpnyCd}, 'ATTD_ID')) AS attdId
